patch.objective: Set up null and alternative hypotheses, interpret a p-value against a significance level, and distinguish Type I from Type II errors
secondaryObjectives: Interpret a 95 percent confidence interval for a mean in plain words

sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch. The six principles include: decisions 'should not be based only on whether a p-value passes a specific threshold'; 'A p-value, or statistical significance, does not measure the size of an effect or the importance of a result'; 'Proper inference requires full reporting and transparency'.
